basePath.description:
URL path prefix the dashboard is served under, for
deployments behind a reverse proxy or Gateway route mounted at a sub-path.
Passed to the container as `--base-path`. Leave empty to serve at the root path.
basePath.title: basePath

extraArgs.description: Extra CLI args passed to the container.
extraArgs.title: extraArgs

global.description: Global values are values that can be accessed from any chart or subchart by exactly the same name.
global.title: global

pullPolicy.description: The image pull policy for the gateway-lens container.
pullPolicy.title: pullPolicy

logLevel.description: Log level for the controller. Passed to the container as `--log-level`.
logLevel.title: logLevel

namespaces.description:
List of namespaces to watch. If empty, all namespaces are watched.
Passed to the container as a comma-separated `--namespaces` flag.
namespaces.title: namespaces

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations to add to the Pod.
podAnnotations.title: podAnnotations

podLabels.description: Extra labels to add to the Pod.
podLabels.title: podLabels

port.description: Port for the dashboard HTTP server. Passed to the container as `--port`.
port.title: port

rbac.description:
RBAC for Gateway API extension CRDs (policies, parametersRef/extensionRef
targets) that gateway-lens discovers at runtime and can't know about
ahead of time. See `charts/gateway-lens/providers/` and the chart README.

extraRules.description:
Additional raw RBAC rules (`apiGroups`/`resources` only — verbs are
always `watch`/`list`/`get`) for CRDs not covered by a provider file, e.g.
`[{apiGroups: ["gateway.example.io"], resources: ["someextensionpolicies"]}]`.
extraRules.title: extraRules

providers.description:
Names of curated provider rule sets to include, each corresponding to
a `providers/<name>.yaml` file shipped in this chart, e.g.
`["nginx-gateway-fabric"]`.
providers.title: providers

rbac.title: rbac

replicaCount.description: Number of gateway-lens Deployment replicas to run.
replicaCount.title: replicaCount

resources.description: Resource requests and/or limits for the gateway-lens container.
resources.title: resources

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ServiceAccount.
annotations.title: annotations

create.description: Whether to create a ServiceAccount for gateway-lens.
create.title: create

name.description: The name of the ServiceAccount to use.
name.title: name
